title: KKE Engine Demo
description: The Kreative Kompas Engine's own building-block demo: a spinning cube, a reference grid, a GPU-simulated particle fountain, seed-based destruction with network-replication discovery, and an orbit camera — all as independent kke::Module instances. Not a game so much as a proof that the engine's pieces work together.

requirements.notes: Best-effort, developer-declared estimates, not automatically measured from the code — see README 'Estimated hardware requirements'. The 20,000-particle GPU compute simulation and RmlUi glyph-atlas textures are the main memory/feature drivers; largePoints affects particle sprite size only and degrades gracefully without it.
